captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. The colored series correspond to the probe |eta| bins: 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.149; The resulting scale factor is 0.8542 +/- 0.0197.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.169; The resulting scale factor is 0.8417 +/- 0.0339.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.208; The resulting scale factor is 0.9553 +/- 0.0605.
captions.mass_fit_bin_03: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.44, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=0.869; The resulting scale factor is 0.9842 +/- 0.0468.
captions.mass_fit_bin_04: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 5 < pT < 7 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=0.945; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.mass_fit_bin_05: Probe bin 1.44 < |eta| < 2.5, 7 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.099; The scale-factor extraction in this bin is invalid and is not exported.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties; bins without a valid fit are omitted. The marker series correspond to the probe |eta| bins listed in the legend.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
